# Tamil Fonts Master Catalog

A comprehensive collection of Tamil fonts split by encoding standards and font styles (Regular, Bold, Italic, BoldItalic, Light, Medium).

## Summary by Encoding Category

| Encoding Category | Font Count | Description |
|---|---|---| 
| **Unicode** | 1038 | Modern standard Tamil OpenType/TrueType fonts (Google Fonts, Lohit, Noto, PostNoBills, Yaldevi, Agastya, etc.) |
| **TACE / TAU / Chemmozhi** | 210 | Tamil Virtual Academy & Govt of Tamil Nadu TACE16/TAU standard fonts |
| **TSCII** | 32 | Tamil Script Code for Information Interchange 8-bit standard fonts |
| **TAB / TAM** | 350 | Tamil Bilingual (TAB) & Monolingual (TAM) legacy fonts |
| **Bamini** | 3 | Classic Bamini typewriter encoding fonts (popular in Sri Lanka & DTP) |
| **Senthamizh & Sundaram** | 57 | Senthamizh and Sundaram series legacy publishing fonts |
| **Vanavil & NLCI** | 87 | Vanavil Avviyar, Vaigai, ThiruValluvar, and NLCI fonts |
| **Modular / SHREE / TMOT** | 50 | Modular InfoTech SHREE and TMOT series Tamil fonts |
| **Chenet** | 149 | Chenet Tamil legacy font series |
| **ATM / Azhagi / Anjal** | 4242 | ATM, Azhagi, Murasu, and Anjal Tamil series fonts |
| **Softview / Agaram / Dinakaran** | 0 | Softview, Agaram, Dinakaran, Vivegam & DTP series fonts |
| **Other Legacy** | 814 | Non-standard legacy & custom DTP fonts |

## Summary by Style & Weight Subfolders

| Style Subfolder | Font Count | Description |
|---|---|---| 
| **Regular** | 3157 | Standard regular weight typefaces |
| **Bold** | 1054 | Bold weight typefaces |
| **Italic** | 1792 | Italic / Oblique slant typefaces |
| **BoldItalic** | 567 | Combined Bold and Italic weight typefaces |
| **Light** | 187 | Light / Thin weight typefaces |
| **Medium_SemiBold** | 275 | Medium, SemiBold, ExtraBold, Black weight typefaces |
